title: The comparator’s aligned forward scan
statement: For any Boolean input word, any valid input-head position, and four finite Boolean words, running the comparator for $j$ steps from its initial scanning configuration reaches the scanning control after $j$ columns, with all work-tape heads at position $j$, whenever $j$ is at most the maximum word length.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is at most the maximum word length
replaced: For every input word, input position, four words, and $j$ at most the common width, running the comparator for $j$ steps from the start reaches the scanning control after $j$ columns with all heads at $j$; every prefix of the forward scan is an actual aligned native run.
